therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: myocardial regeneration and ventricular functional recovery
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with left ventricular dysfunction undergoing coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Number of patients with serious adverse events at 12 months (composite of sustained ventricular arrhythmias, sudden unexpected death, ectopic tissue formation)

results.effect_size: 0 SAEs in treated group vs 1 SAE in placebo group at 12 months
biomarker_changes: Infarct scar size decreased by -2.37g (treated) vs -2.16g (placebo) at 6 months
Infarct scar size decreased by -5.91g (treated) vs -5.32g (placebo) at 18 months
Regional LV wall thickening improved from 20.68mm to 47.87mm (treated) vs 32.21mm to 42.09mm (placebo) at 18 months
LVEF change baseline to 18 months: +2.50% (treated) vs +14.61% (placebo)
Serial troponin and CK-MB values post-CABG were comparable between groups
Clinically significant hematology values: 6 (treated) vs 0 (placebo); clinical chemistry values: 9 (treated) vs 0 (placebo)
subgroup_findings: NYHA functional class improved in 3 treated vs 1 placebo patient from baseline to 6 months
Six-minute walk test median change: +67m (treated) vs -30m (placebo) at 6 months
Minnesota Living with Heart Failure score at 6 months: 11.5 (treated) vs 54.5 (placebo)
Abnormal 48-hour ambulatory ECG at 18 months: 5 treated vs 2 placebo participants
safety_signals: Complete atrioventricular block in 1/4 higher-dose MSC patients
Ventricular tachycardia in 1/4 higher-dose MSC and 1/3 placebo patients
Post-procedural hemorrhage in 1/4 higher-dose MSC patients
Transient ischemic attack in 1/4 higher-dose MSC patients
Renal failure in 1/4 higher-dose MSC patients
Large intestine perforation in 1/3 placebo patients
Procedural site reaction in 1/3 placebo patients
Mean treatment-emergent AEs at 18 months: 11 (treated) vs 6 (placebo)
Trial terminated due to difficulty in recruitment with only 9 patients enrolled

dose_info.dose: Lower dose: 2×10^7 cells (2 million MSCs per injection); Higher dose: 2×10^8 cells (20 million MSCs per injection)
dose_info.schedule: Single administration of 10–20 intramyocardial injections following completion of CABG surgery

context.indication: Left ventricular dysfunction in patients undergoing coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery
context.comparator: Placebo (phosphate buffered saline + 1% human serum albumin intramyocardial injections)
context.investigator_commentary: Trial terminated due to difficulty in recruitment. Only 9 patients enrolled out of planned sample.
